content:
The five known volumes sum to \(4200\).

For pyramids on opposite faces, the volumes in each opposite pair must have the same sum. The only way to pair four of the known volumes with equal sums is

\[
200+1400=1600,\qquad 500+1100=1600.
\]

So the remaining known volume \(1000\) pairs with the unknown \(x\):

\[
x+1000=1600.
\]

Thus

\[
x=600.
\]

\[
\boxed{600}
\]
